summary: Frontend-only regression test for Intl Shipments polish features. Login (empty fields) and navigation to Intl Shipments work fine. Attention chip for IS-0011 correctly reads 'Awaiting prepayment' and no console errors occur. However, the majority of the requested polish features are NOT implemented in /app/frontend/src/IntlShipmentsPage.tsx — KPI cells are still non-interactive <div>s, the search has no clear (X) button, drafts do not use the custom 'Needs packing list' chip label, and there is no chevron-on-hover for rows.

ui_bugs.issue: KPI cells are <div class='is-kpi'> (not buttons). Missing data-testid='is-kpi-all' and data-testid='is-kpi-released'. No onClick handler to filter by status; no '.on' active class toggling. Clicking 'Released' KPI does not filter to Prepaid.

No inline clear (X) button appears inside .is-search when text is present. data-testid='is-search-clear' does not exist. A separate 'is-clear-filters' pill exists in the filter row, but the request is specifically for a clear icon inside the search field.
Draft rows render 'Draft' via STATUS_LABEL. Spec requires the attention chip to read 'Needs packing list' for drafts (and 'Awaiting prepayment' for prepayment — which is already correct).

No chevron pseudo-element on hover. There is no .is-c4--last class in the DOM (row uses .is-c4) and no ::after rule targeting it in intlshipments.css. Computed opacity of ::after on hover returns 'none' (no content).

action_items: Convert the two KPI cells (In pipeline / Released) into <button> elements. Add data-testid='is-kpi-all' on the pipeline KPI (or an explicit 'All' cell) that resets fStatus to 'all', and data-testid='is-kpi-released' on the Released KPI. Toggle a '.on' class when active and set fStatus='prepaid' when engaged; second click clears back to 'all'.
Inside .is-search, render an X button with data-testid='is-search-clear' when q.trim() is non-empty; on click it should setQ('').
In the attention chip (button.is-attn), replace {STATUS_LABEL[s.status]} with 'Needs packing list' when s.status === 'draft' (keep 'Awaiting prepayment' otherwise).

Add a chevron via a ::after pseudo-element on the last row cell. Rename the trailing <span className='is-c4'> to className='is-c4 is-c4--last' (or add a dedicated class) and add the CSS rule so opacity is 0 by default and 1 on .is-tr.is-row:hover .is-c4--last::after.
critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 380 lines with two large components in one file — consider splitting Detail into its own module and extracting inline styles for maintainability.
Row uses a native <button> that contains block-level flex children — accessible but ensure keyboard focus states remain visible (currently only hover chevron requested).
The 'is-clear-filters' button already exists but is separate from the search field; the requested inline X should be additional, not replace it.

success_rate.frontend: 25% (1 of 4 polish features present; core regression flows still pass)

test_credentials: Login with empty email+password to sign in as demo (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: None. All data is in-memory client seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The polish features listed in review_request are not yet in code. After E1 implements them, re-run: (1) click is-kpi-released → only IS-0012 visible and is-filter-status='prepaid'; (2) click is-kpi-all → 3 rows; (3) type in is-search → is-search-clear visible → click clears; (4) create draft via is-new-shipment (customer 'A', factory 'B') → verify is-attn-<newId> text contains 'Needs packing list'; (5) hover is-row-IS-0012 → computed opacity of .is-c4--last::after == '1'.
rca of the issue: E1 announced polish features but did not commit corresponding changes to IntlShipmentsPage.tsx or intlshipments.css. KPI cells remain <div>s (lines 150-152), search has no inline clear button (line 159), attention chip uses STATUS_LABEL directly (line 147) so drafts render 'Draft', and CSS has no .is-c4--last::after rule.
